description: List a domain's LIVE DNS records as Cloudflare holds them, each with its orange-cloud (`proxied`) state and whether it is `proxiable` at all. Once a domain has moved to Cloudflare THIS is the authoritative record set — list_dns_records reads the Porkbun zone, which is no longer answering queries for it. Returns ZONE_NOT_READY if the zone does not exist yet.

domain.description: Domain whose Cloudflare zone to inspect.

name: get_cloudflare_records
title: Get Cloudflare Records
